posts.title: The Writing Year in Review
posts.description: It’s become obligatory to start any year-end review by noting that 2017 was a gaping hell pit of a year and it was. So, there you go. Personally speaking, it was pretty good, despite the blazing horrors going on around us. My son turned three and watching him grow and learn remains the most profound […]

posts.title: The Gods of Ghibli
posts.description: I have a new essay up at Tor.com, about the gods and spirits in the films of Hayao Miyazaki, their often fraught relationship with mankind, and their uneasy overlap with Japanese Shintoism and Buddhism– “Gods and Spirits (….and Whatever Totoro Is): Exploring Miyazaki’s Fantasy World.” Miyazaki’s movies aren’t religious or even mythological, at least in […]
